# Blode Icons — full agent guide

> Beautifully crafted SVG icons for React — MIT licensed, tree-shakeable, with 579 verified Lucide-compatible names.

## Overview

Blode Icons is a curated SVG icon library (~2,000 outline icons with filled variants) published as the npm package `blode-icons-react`. The docs site lives at https://blode.co/icons.

Design goals for agents:

1. Discover the library via `llms.txt` / MCP server card
2. Search by natural language, kebab slug, or Lucide name
3. Install via npm (preferred) or copy TSX from the registry/API
4. Confirm license is MIT on every `get_icon` response

## License

MIT. Free for personal and commercial use. No attribution required.

## Package API

Public entrypoints:

| Path | Exports |
| --- | --- |
| `blode-icons-react` | Named icon components (`*Icon`), Lucide aliases, `LucideProps`, `LucideIcon` |
| `blode-icons-react/icons/<kebab>` | Default export for one icon |
| `blode-icons-react/dynamic` | `DynamicIcon` lazy loader |
| `blode-icons-react/dynamicIconImports` | Import map keyed by export names |

Naming:

- Full library: PascalCase + `Icon` suffix (`SearchIcon`, `ChevronDownIcon`)
- Lucide aliases: PascalCase without suffix for the 579 verified names (`Search`, `ChevronDown`). Unverified names are not exported, so a bad import fails at build time rather than rendering the wrong icon
- File paths: kebab-case (`blode-icons-react/icons/airplane`)
- Filled variants: `{Name}FilledIcon`

Props (Lucide-compatible):

- `size` — width and height (default `24`)
- `color` — stroke/fill color (default `currentColor`)
- `strokeWidth` — stroke width (default `2`)
- `absoluteStrokeWidth` — scale stroke with size like lucide-react

## HTTP API

Base URL: `https://blode.co/icons`

```
GET /api/icons/search?q={query}&limit={n}&style={OUTLINE|SOLID}
GET /api/icons/{slug}/svg
GET /api/icons/{slug}/tsx
GET /api/openapi.json
GET /api/health
GET /api/stats
```

Search returns JSON documents with `slug`, `name`, `title`, `tags`, `category`, `hasFilled`, and `lucideAliases`.

## MCP

Endpoint: `https://blode.co/icons/mcp` (Streamable HTTP)

Tools:

### search_icons

Search icons by keyword, Lucide name, tag, or category.

Arguments:

- `query` (string, required)
- `limit` (number, optional, default 25, max 100)
- `style` (`OUTLINE` | `SOLID`, optional)

### get_icon

Fetch one icon by kebab slug (or Lucide PascalCase name).

Arguments:

- `name` (string, required) — e.g. `settings-gear-1` or `Settings`
- `format` (`svg` | `tsx` | `both`, optional, default `both`)

Returns MIT license, import snippet, component name, and source.

### get_usage

Return the agent usage guide (install commands, import shapes, MCP workflow, registry URLs). No arguments.

Resource: `blode-icons://docs/usage` (same markdown).

## shadcn registry

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://blode.co/icons/r/magnifying-glass.json
```

Registry index: https://blode.co/icons/r/registry.json

Configure in `components.json`:

```json
{
  "registries": {
    "@blode": "https://blode.co/icons/r/{name}.json"
  }
}
```

## Skill install

```bash
npx skills add mblode/blode-icons -g --all -y
```
